findings.explanation: The Opportunity query runs once per account inside the for loop, so more than 100 accounts exceed the 100-query limit.
findings.fix: Collect the account IDs, run one aggregate query (SUM(Amount) GROUP BY AccountId) before the loop, and read totals from a map.

findings.explanation: update acc runs once per account, so more than 150 accounts exceed the DML statement limit.
findings.fix: Set the rating in the loop, then run one update on the whole list after the loop.

findings.explanation: countOpenCases() runs a COUNT() query (line 19) and is called once per account inside the loop, so more than 100 accounts exceed the query limit. The scanner cannot see this because the query lives in a helper method.
findings.fix: Run one aggregate query (SELECT AccountId, COUNT(Id) FROM Case WHERE AccountId IN :ids AND IsClosed = false WITH USER_MODE GROUP BY AccountId) before the loop and look counts up in a map.

findings.explanation: searchTerm is user input joined directly into the query text on line 12, so a value containing a quote can change the WHERE clause. WITH USER_MODE limits the damage but does not prevent the injection.
findings.fix: Use a bind variable: String pattern = '%' + searchTerm + '%'; then WHERE LastName LIKE :pattern (or Database.queryWithBinds).

findings.explanation: Database.update(inv, false) runs once per invoice, so more than 150 paid invoices exceed the DML statement limit.
findings.fix: Update the fields in the loop, then call Database.update(invoices, false) once after it and inspect the SaveResults.

findings.explanation: Only Trigger.new[0] is processed, so in a data load or bulk API batch every opportunity after the first is silently skipped.
findings.fix: Loop over Trigger.new and apply the rule to every record.

findings.explanation: AccountService has no sharing keyword, so it runs with the sharing of its caller or, from a trigger, without sharing.
findings.fix: Declare the class 'public with sharing class AccountService' (or inherited sharing if that is intended).

findings.explanation: The Opportunity query ignores the running user's object and field permissions.
findings.fix: Add WITH USER_MODE to the query.

findings.explanation: getTopAccounts returns Account names and revenue without checking the user's permissions on Account or AnnualRevenue.
The finance queue ID '00G5g000004XyZaEAK' differs between sandboxes and production, so records get an invalid owner after deployment.
findings.fix: Look up the queue by DeveloperName (SELECT Id FROM Group WHERE Type = 'Queue' AND DeveloperName = 'Finance') or store it in Custom Metadata.

findings.explanation: The record type ID '0125g000000ABCDAAA' is org-specific and will not match in other orgs.
QueryException is swallowed, so a failed search shows the user nothing and leaves no trace.
findings.fix: Show an error with ApexPages.addMessage (or rethrow / log) and set results to an empty list.

findings.explanation: System.debug left in production code adds log noise and CPU cost.
findings.fix: Remove it or replace it with the project's logging framework.

notes: InvoiceSyncService.cls line 19: Database.update(..., false) discards the SaveResult, so failed invoice updates are lost silently. Check the results and log or retry failures.
AccountService.cls line 19 and CaseEscalationService.cls line 15: DML runs in system mode. Consider 'update as user' to match the user-mode queries elsewhere in the project.
ContactSearchController.cls line 12: a null searchTerm produces LIKE '%null%'. Guard against blank input before querying.
LeadConversionService.cls and ContactTrigger.trigger follow best practice; no issues found.
